name: Zippy Spaghetti Sauce
description: A flavorful and spicy spaghetti sauce with sausage, hamburger, and taco seasoning.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the hamburger and chopped onion.
Add garlic, oregano, salt, pepper, and taco seasoning.
Chop the summer sausage into 1/4 inch pieces and add to the mixture.
Add the Ragu spaghetti sauce and drained mushrooms.
Simmer for 10 minutes.

keywords: spaghetti sauce, zippy sauce, sausage, taco seasoning

_similar.name: Pizza Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty pizza-inspired casserole with pasta, pepperoni, and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Melt margarine and sauté chopped onion until soft.
Add tomato sauce, mushrooms, oregano, and basil. Stir and remove from heat.
Cook pasta in boiling water with oil and salt for 8 to 10 minutes until tender but firm. Drain.
Combine cooked pasta with Parmesan cheese and 1 cup mozzarella cheese in a 3-quart casserole.
Scatter pepperoni slices over the pasta mixture.
Cover with the tomato-onion sauce and sprinkle with remaining mozzarella cheese.
Bake, uncovered, in a 350°F oven for 30 minutes.

_similar.keywords: pizza casserole, pasta bake, pepperoni, mozzarella cheese

_similar.name: Baked Spaghetti and Meatballs
_similar.description: A hearty baked pasta dish featuring meatballs, spaghetti, and a rich tomato-based sauce topped with melted mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F and start boiling water for cooking spaghetti.
In a large bowl, mix ground beef, chopped onion, egg, Worcestershire sauce, and black pepper. Form into meatballs.
Fry the meatballs in a skillet until completely cooked, turning gently with tongs. Drain off excess fat.
Add spaghetti sauce, diced tomatoes, mushrooms, green pepper, and oregano to the skillet. Simmer for approximately 15 minutes.
Cook spaghetti until 'al dente', then rinse and drain.
Combine cooked spaghetti with sour cream.
Pour the spaghetti mixture into a greased 6-cup casserole dish. Sprinkle with half of the shredded mozzarella cheese.
Cover with the sauce and meatball mixture. Bake, uncovered, at 350°F for approximately 20 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese and bake for an additional 5 to 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

_similar.name: Chicken Supreme
_similar.description: A hearty chicken dish with tomatoes, herbs, and cheese, baked to perfection and served over rice or pasta.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil the chicken breasts in a separate container until pink is gone (about 1/4 of the way cooked).
In a baking or roasting pan, mix together the tomato ingredients (stewed tomatoes, green pepper, onion, basil, oregano, garlic).
Place the partially cooked chicken breasts in the bottom of the pan.
Sprinkle spices over the chicken breasts.
Pour the remaining tomato mixture on top of the chicken breasts.
Cover and bake at 350°F for approximately ½ hour.
Sprinkle grated cheese on top, cover, and bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Serve over rice or pasta.

_similar.keywords: chicken supreme, baked chicken, Italian-style chicken

_similar.name: Garfield's Lasagna
_similar.description: A hearty layered lasagna with ground beef, cottage cheese, and mozzarella, perfect for a crowd.
recipeIngredient: 10 oz can mushroom pieces and stems

recipeInstructions.text: Thoroughly brown the ground beef in a frying pan. Add onions and garlic; cook until tender.
Add spaghetti sauce, diced tomatoes, mushrooms, oregano, and salt. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook lasagna noodles as directed on the package. Rinse noodles in cold water using a colander.
Blend cottage cheese with approximately 2 cups of the mozzarella cheese.
Spread a thin layer of sauce in a greased 9x13 inch pan. Alternately layer 1/3 each of the noodles, sauce, and cheese mixture. Repeat 2 times until you have 3 layers.
Sprinkle remaining mozzarella cheese on top. Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

_similar.keywords: lasagna, ground beef, cottage cheese, mozzarella, layered pasta
